probes.name: A0-comment-only-GREEN-control
probes.subject: benchmarks/intake_extraction/run_benchmark.py
probes.old:
index: int
    content: str | None
    model: str | None
    error: str | None = None
    done_reason: str | None = None
probes.new:
index: int  # negative control: a comment cannot change behaviour
    content: str | None
    model: str | None
    error: str | None = None
    done_reason: str | None = None
probes.note: negative control: a comment-only edit must change nothing. This green is what rules out 'the battery's own edit/restore broke something' for every probe below.

probes.note: this is the AC-6 latency clause; the earlier asserts on done_reason/eval_count stay green, isolating it

probes.name: A4-truncated-oracle-keyed-wrong
